data.name: Freezing Trap
data.description: The trap creates a burst of ice that damages and encases the triggering creature. The creature takes 1d3+%1 points of cold damage and is entangled and stuck to the ground, similar to the effect of a tanglefoot bag. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and means the creature is not stuck to the floor by the ice. The ice is %2 inches thick, has hardness 0 and %3 hit points, and melts in 2d4 rounds.|FreezingTrapBonusDamage|FreezingTrapThickness|FreezingTrapHP
